description: This Java source file implements the UserService interface, providing user management functionalities such as creating users, assigning roles, listing roles, and enabling/disabling users within a backend system. It interacts with user and role repositories, and employs Spring annotations for dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the UserService interface, handling user creation, role assignment, retrieval operations, and status toggling in the context of an insurance management backend.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified details and roles, encoding the password and ensuring email uniqueness.

methods.name: assignRoles
methods.description: Assigns a set of roles to an existing user identified by userId.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email, returning an Optional<User>.

methods.name: listRoles
methods.description: Lists all roles available in the system.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a user account based on the provided boolean flag.

methods.name: resolveRoles
methods.description: Resolves role names to Role entities, creating default or missing roles as needed.
